Nodes.name: Fusion:Core_with_desc
Nodes.content:
Nodes:
  Internal:CleanLogs:
    action: executeCleanLogs
    group: MCU-Internal
    inputs:
      _Data: any
    outputs:
      _Count: any
    config:
    - label: Older Than (days)
      name: olderThan
      type: number
    - label: Keep Error
      name: keepError
      type: boolean
    - label: Keep Debug
      name: keepDebug
      type: boolean
    - label: Keep Info
      name: keepInfo
      type: boolean
    description: |
      This node clears log records based on age and severity thresholds. It evaluates configuration, computes a cutoff date, and removes logs older than that date unless their level is explicitly marked to be kept.

      The node processes input data to validate configuration, constructs a list of log levels to preserve based on boolean config flags, calculates a cutoff timestamp using the olderThan number of days, and then calls adapter.emptyLogByQual to delete logs matching the age and level criteria.

      Args:
        _Data (any): Input data passed to the node for validation and processing.

      Returns:
        _Count (any): Number of log records removed by the clean operation.

      Config:
        olderThan (number): Number of days in the past to use as cutoff for log retention.
        keepError (boolean): If true, error-level logs will not be deleted even if older than cutoff.
        keepDebug (boolean): If true, debug-level logs will not be deleted even if older than cutoff.
        keepInfo (boolean): If true, info-level logs will not be deleted even if older than cutoff.
  Internal:CleanInboundQueue:
    action: executeCleanInboundQueue
    group: MCU-Internal
    inputs:
      _Data: any
    outputs:
      _Count: any
    config:
    - label: Older Than (days)
      name: olderThan
      type: number
    description: |
      This node cleans old successful messages from the Inbound queue based on a user-specified age threshold.

      The node evaluates configuration and uses the provided olderThan value to compute a cutoff date. It then deletes records from the Inbound queue where the status is 'success' and the creation date is earlier than the cutoff. If an error occurs during this process, it logs an error message but does not propagate an exception or set any _Error output.

      Args:
        _Data (any): Input data passed through to the node.

      Returns:
        _Count (any): Number of records deleted from the queue.

      Config:
        olderThan (number): Number of days to retain; messages older than this will be deleted.
  Internal:CleanOutboundQueue:
    action: executeCleanOutboundQueue
    group: MCU-Internal
    inputs:
      _Data: any
    outputs:
      _Count: any
    config:
    - label: Older Than (days)
      name: olderThan
      type: number
    description: |
      Summary:
      This node clears succeeded messages from the Outbound queue that are older than a specified number of days.

      The node evaluates its configuration using evaluateConfig with the _Data input. It calculates a cutoff date by subtracting the olderThan number of days from the current date, then calls adapter.deleteFromQueueByQual with a query that targets messages in the Outbound queue with status success and creation date earlier than the cutoff. If an exception occurs during execution, it logs an error message including the flow name, node label, and exception details; no explicit _Error output is assigned in this implementation, but the Returns schema declares _Count and since _Error is not listed, no error output is declared.

      Args:
        _Data (any): Input data passed through the node.

      Returns:
        _Count (any): Number of messages deleted from the Outbound queue.

      Config:
        olderThan (number): Number of days in the past to retain succeeded messages; messages older than this are deleted.
  Internal:CleanProcessingQueue:
    action: executeCleanProcessingQueue
    group: MCU-Internal
    inputs:
      _Data: any
    outputs:
      _Count: any
    config:
    - label: Older Than (days)
      name: olderThan
      type: number
    description: |
      The node cleans old successful records from the Processing queue based on age.

      It calculates a cutoff date by subtracting the configured number of days from the current date, then deletes records from the Processing queue where the status is success and the creation date is earlier than the cutoff. It uses adapter.deleteFromQueueByQual to perform the deletion and logs any errors encountered during the process.

      Args:
        _Data (any):

      Returns:
        _Count (any):

      Config:
        olderThan (number): Number of days in the past to use as the cutoff for deleting old successful queue records.
  BMC:SendRemedyAttachment:
    group: BMC
    action: sendRemedyAttachment
    inputs:
      _Data: any
    outputs:
      _Result: any
      _Error: any
    config:
    - label: Endpoint
      name: endpoint
      type: string
    - label: Key Token
      name: keyToken
      type: string
    - label: Form
      name: form
      type: string
    - label: List of Attachment Fields
      name: attachmentFieldList
      type: string
    - label: Values
      name: values
      type: string
    - label: Field to Return
      name: fieldToReturn
      type: string
    - label: Proxy
      name: proxy
      type: string
    - label: Proxy Port
      name: proxyPort
      type: number
    - label: Proxy User
      name: proxyUser
      type: string
    - label: Proxy Password
      name: proxyPassword
      type: string
    description: |
      The node sends attachments to a BMC Remedy entry by constructing a multipart HTTP POST request using provided configuration and input data, handles proxy authentication if configured, and returns either the result or an error.

      The operation begins by evaluating the configuration and building the endpoint URL. It splits the attachment field list, loads each attachment from storage, updates the values map with filenames, and builds a multipart request body containing JSON entry data and attachment streams. The HTTP request uses the authorization token from flowStore and configures proxy settings if proxy, port, user, and password are provided. It executes the request and checks the response code: on success (2xx), it parses and returns the specified field; on non-2xx responses or exceptions, it constructs and logs an error record.

      Args:
        _Data (any): Input data used for configuration evaluation

      Returns:
        _Result (any): Contains the value of the specified fieldToReturn on successful request
        _Error (any): Contains status, statusText, and body on failure or exception

      Config:
        endpoint (string): Base URL for BMC Remedy instance
        keyToken (string): Key to retrieve authorization token from flowStore
        form (string): Name of the Remedy form to target
        attachmentFieldList (string): Comma-separated list of attachment field names
        values (string): JSON string or map containing field values including attachment references
        fieldToReturn (string): Name of the field whose value should be returned on success
        proxy (string): Proxy server hostname or IP address
        proxyPort (number): Proxy server port number
        proxyUser (string): Proxy authentication username
        proxyPassword (string): Proxy authentication password
  BMC:UpdateRemedyAttachment:
    group: BMC
    action: updateRemedyAttachment
    inputs:
      _Data: any
    outputs:
      _Result: any
      _Error: any
    config:
    - label: Endpoint
      name: endpoint
      type: string
    - label: Key Token
      name: keyToken
      type: string
    - label: Form
      name: form
      type: string
    - label: Entry ID
      name: entryId
      type: string
    - label: List of Attachment Fields
      name: attachmentFieldList
      type: string
    - label: Values
      name: values
      type: string
    - label: Proxy
      name: proxy
      type: string
    - label: Proxy Port
      name: proxyPort
      type: number
    - label: Proxy User
      name: proxyUser
      type: string
    - label: Proxy Password
      name: proxyPassword
      type: string
    description: |
      This node updates entries in BMC Remedy by attaching files to specified fields using a multipart HTTP PUT request to the Remedy API. It retrieves attachments from storage, updates the request body with both JSON data and file attachments, and handles authentication via a token stored in flowStore.

      The node first evaluates configuration and constructs the API endpoint using the provided form and entry ID. It splits the attachmentFieldList into individual fields, loads each attachment using adapter.loadAttachment, updates the values map with the attachment filenames, and stores attachment metadata for later use. During iteration over attachment fields, it builds a multipart form body that includes a JSON entry part and separately adds each attachment as a part named "attach-<fieldName>". It configures HTTP proxy and proxy authentication if proxy details are provided, executes the PUT request, and inspects the response. If the response code is in the 2xx range, it sets _Result to _Data; otherwise, it constructs an error response with status, statusText, and parsed body, logs the error, and returns early. In case of any exception during execution, it sets _Error with a generic 500 status and logs the stack trace.

      Args:
        _Data (any): Input data passed into the node for processing.

      Returns:
        _Result (any): Output data produced on successful completion, identical to the input _Data.

        _Error (any): Error object containing status code, status text, and error body on failure.

      Config:
        endpoint (string): Base URL of the BMC Remedy API server.

        keyToken (string): Key used to retrieve the authorization token from flowStore.

        form (string): Name of the Remedy form to update.

        entryId (string): ID of the specific entry within the form to update.

        attachmentFieldList (string): Comma-separated list of field names that contain attachments.

        values (string): JSON string or map of values to include in the entry update.

        proxy (string): Hostname or IP address of the HTTP proxy server.

        proxyPort (number): Port number of the HTTP proxy server.

        proxyUser (string): Username for authenticating with the HTTP proxy.

        proxyPassword (string): Password for authenticating with the HTTP proxy.
  BMC:StoreRemedyAttachment:
    group: BMC
    action: storeRemedyAttachment
    inputs:
      _DataIn: any
    outputs:
      _DataOut: any
      _Error: any
    config:
    - label: Key Token
      name: keyToken
      type: string
    - label: Attachment Fields
      name: attachmentField
      type: string
    - label: Field Name for eBonding Attachment ID
      name: eBondingFieldName
      type: string
    - label: Proxy
      name: proxy
      type: string
    - label: Proxy Port
      name: proxyPort
      type: number
    - label: Proxy User
      name: proxyUser
      type: string
    - label: Proxy Password
      name: proxyPassword
      type: string
    description: |
      The node retrieves attachments from BMC Remedy by iterating over input records and specified attachment fields, stores them locally, and updates the records with the generated attachment IDs.

      It processes each input record by splitting the attachmentField config into field names, validating the presence of name, sizeBytes, and href in each attachment object, then performing an HTTP GET request using an authorization token from flowStore. If the HTTP request succeeds, it stores the attachment and adds an attachment ID field to the record. Errors during HTTP calls are captured with status, statusText, and body, while exceptions in execution result in a 500 error.

      Args:
        _DataIn (any): Input data containing records with attachment objects.

      Returns:
        _DataOut (any): Output data with records updated by attachment IDs.
        _Error (any): Error details including status, statusText, and body.

      Config:
        keyToken (string): Token name used to retrieve authorization header value from flowStore.
        attachmentField (string): Comma-separated list of field names containing attachment metadata per record.
        eBondingFieldName (string): Name of the field to store the local attachment ID in the attachment object, defaults to 'ebondingAttachmentId' if not configured.
        proxy (string): Proxy server address for HTTP requests.
        proxyPort (number): Proxy server port for HTTP requests.
        proxyUser (string): Username for proxy authentication.
        proxyPassword (string): Password for proxy authentication.
  Core:UpdateTicketStore:
    action: coreUpdateTicketStore
    group: TicketStore
    inputs:
      _Data: any
    outputs:
      _Out: any
      _Error: any
    config:
    - label: SourceSystem
      name: sourceSystem
      type: string
    - label: SourceSystemID
      name: sourceSystemID
      type: string
    - label: SourceSystemEntity
      name: sourceSystemEntity
      type: string
    - label: TargetSystem
      name: targetSystem
      type: string
    - label: TargetSystemID
      name: targetSystemID
      type: string
    - label: targetSystemEntity
      name: targetSystemEntity
      type: string
    - label: Mode
      name: mode
      type: string
    - label: Status
      name: status
      type: string
    description: |
      This node updates a ticket store by creating a digital twin and then modifying an existing outbound queue document with updated metadata and optional mode/status fields.

      The node first validates configuration and invokes adapter.createDigitalTwin with source and target system parameters. It then constructs a query to find queue documents in the "Outbound" queue matching source and target system metadata. The first matching document is retrieved, and its metadata is updated with the targetSystemID from config, along with mode and status if provided. If any exception occurs during execution, an error object is created with status 500 and logged.

      Args:
        _Data (any): Input data flow that provides the source or payload context for ticket store update

      Returns:
        _Out (any): Output data flow passed through after successful queue update
        _Error (any): Error object with status, statusText, and body fields set on failure

      Config:
        sourceSystem (string): Identifies the source system in the integration context
        sourceSystemID (string): Unique identifier for the source system instance
        sourceSystemEntity (string): Entity type within the source system
        targetSystem (string): Identifies the target system in the integration context
        targetSystemID (string): Unique identifier for the target system instance
        targetSystemEntity (string): Entity type within the target system
        mode (string): Optional operational mode to apply during ticket update
        status (string): Optional status value to apply during ticket update
  Core:UpdateInboundTicketStatus:
    action: coreUpdateInboundTicketStatus
    group: TicketStore
    inputs:
      _Data: any
    outputs:
      _Out: any
      _Error: any
    config:
    - label: SourceSystem
      name: sourceSystem
      type: string
    - label: SourceSystemID
      name: sourceSystemID
      type: string
    - label: SourceSystemEntity
      name: sourceSystemEntity
      type: string
    - label: QueryStatus
      name: queryStatus
      type: string
    - label: Status
      name: status
      type: string
    description: |
      This node updates the status of a single inbound ticket matching specific criteria in the queue. It first searches for a document in the "Inbound" queue using constructed query criteria, then updates the first matching document's status if found.

      The node uses the configured source system, ID, entity, and query status to locate the ticket. It then updates the ticket's status to the configured value. If an error occurs during execution, it captures the exception and sets an error output.

      Args:
        _Data (any): Input data passed into the node for processing

      Returns:
        _Out (any): Output data returned when processing completes successfully
        _Error (any): Error structure containing status code, status text, and error body when an exception occurs

      Config:
        sourceSystem (string): Source system identifier used in the ticket search
        sourceSystemID (string): Unique identifier from the source system used in the ticket search
        sourceSystemEntity (string): Entity name from the source system used in the ticket search
        queryStatus (string): Current status value used to locate matching tickets in the queue
        status (string): Target status value to apply to the matched ticket
  Core:JsonResponse:
    action: coreJsonResponse
    group: Json
    inputs:
      _Data: any
    outputs:
      _Out: any
    config:
    - label: Status
      name: status
      type: string
      defaultValue: '200'
    - label: Headers
      name: headers
      type: string
      defaultValue: '[:]'
    - label: $Body
      name: body
      type: string
      rows: 8
    description: |
      This node constructs a JSON HTTP response using configuration values for status, headers, and body. It processes input data through config evaluation and maps the result into an output structure containing all three response components.

      The node iterates over configData entries using .each{} to prepend '$e:' to values of the status, headers, and body fields, indicating expression evaluation will be performed later. It then calls evaluateConfig to bind _Data to the node's input, extracts the processed config values (status, headers, body), and assembles them into a map stored in _Out. If any exception occurs during processing, an error is logged but _Error is not assigned.

      Args:
        _Data (any): Input data passed into the node for use in expression evaluation

      Returns:
        _Out (any): Output map containing status, headers, and body fields forming the JSON response

      Config:
        status (string): HTTP status code as a string; defaults to '200'
        headers (string): HTTP headers represented as a string; defaults to '[:]'
        body (string): Response body content as a string; supports multi-line input via 8-row text area
  Core:Join:
    action: coreJoin
    group: Logic
    inputs:
      _Data: any
    outputs:
      _Out: any
    description: |
      This node assigns its input directly to its sole output without modification.

      The node receives input data via the _Data channel and copies it unchanged to the _Out channel. There are no iterations, conditionals, or side effects in the operation.

      Args:
        _Data (any): Input data to be passed through unchanged.

      Returns:
        _Out (any): Output data identical to the input.

      Config:
        _none (any): This node does not declare Config fields.
  BMC:QO:
    action: bmcQO
    group: BMC
    inputs:
      _Data: any
    outputs:
      _Out: any
      _Error: any
    config:
    - label: ID Field
      name: idField
      type: string
      defaultValue: Entry ID
    - label: Entity
      name: entity
      type: string
    description: |
      This node processes input data records for BMC QO by parsing date fields and restructuring each record with metadata.

      The node parses the 'Submit Date' and 'Last Modified Date' fields of each input record into date objects, then constructs a new list with the record's ID (from the configurable idField), original content, parsed create and modify timestamps, and the configured entity value. If any error occurs, it assigns a 500-level error object to _Error and logs the full exception.

      Args:
        _Data (any): Input data array to process

      Returns:
        _Out (any): Processed records array with id, content, created, modified, and entity fields
        _Error (any): Error object set when exception occurs

      Config:
        idField (string): Field name to use as the record ID
        entity (string): Entity name to attach to each output record
  Core:AddToInboundQueue:
    action: executeAddToInboundQueue
    group: Flow
    inputs:
      _Data: any
    outputs:
      _Out: any
      _Error: any
    config:
    - label: Name Of Gateway
      name: nameOfGateway
      type: string
    - label: ID
      name: id
      type: string
    - label: Entity
      name: entity
      type: string
    - label: Payload
      name: payload
      type: string
    description: |
      This node adds a message to the inbound queue by constructing a queue object using configuration and input data.

      The node first evaluates its configuration using the provided input data. It then builds a queue object containing metadata with gateway name, entity, and ID from config, current timestamps, status set to "new", and content derived from the payload config field. The queue object is submitted to the "Inbound" queue via adapter.addToQueue. If successful, the constructed queue object is emitted on _Out. If any exception occurs during execution, an error payload with status 500 and the exception details is assigned to _Error, and an error log is written.

      Args:
        _Data (any): Input data used to evaluate configuration.

      Returns:
        _Out (any): The constructed queue object sent to the inbound queue on success.
        _Error (any): Error details including status, statusText, and body on failure.

      Config:
        nameOfGateway (string): The source system name used in queue metadata.
        id (string): The source system ID used in queue metadata and additional fields.
        entity (string): The source system entity used in queue metadata.
        payload (string): The content of the message to be added to the queue.
  BMC:IQO-Incident:
    action: bmcIQOIncident
    group: BMC
    inputs:
      _Data: any
    outputs:
      _Out: any
      _Error: any
    description: |
      This node processes input incident data by parsing date fields and normalizing the records into a structured format.

      It iterates over each item in the _Data list, parses the Submit Date and Last Modified Date fields into date objects using a SimpleDateFormat, and constructs a new map containing the Entry ID, original content, parsed created/modified timestamps, and a fixed entity label. Errors during processing result in a 500 status response being assigned to the _Error output.

      Args:
        _Data (any): Input data containing incident records with Submit Date and Last Modified Date fields

      Returns:
        _Out (any): Normalized list of incident records with id, content, created, modified, and entity fields
        _Error (any): Error response object with status, statusText, and body fields when an exception occurs

      Config:
        _none (any): This node does not declare Config fields.
  BMC:InputQueueObject:
    action: bmcInputQueueObject
    group: BMC
    inputs:
      _Data: any
    outputs:
      _Out: any
      _Error: any
    config:
    - label: Entity
      name: entity
      type: string
    description: |
      This node processes input data entries from a BMC queue by parsing date fields and structuring each entry into a standardized output with metadata.

      It iterates over each item in the _Data list, parses the Submit Date and Last Modified Date fields into date objects, and constructs a result list where each entry includes an id, the original content, parsed created and modified timestamps, and the configured entity name. If any error occurs during parsing or processing, it assigns a detailed error object to _Error and logs the error with context.

      Args:
        _Data (any): Input data containing queue entries with Submit Date and Last Modified Date fields

      Returns:
        _Out (any): Processed list of entries with id, content, created, modified, and entity fields
        _Error (any): Error object populated when an exception occurs, containing status, statusText, and body

      Config:
        entity (string): Entity name used to tag each output record
  BMC:RemedyLogin:
    group: BMC
    action: remedyLogin
    inputs:
      _DataIn: any
    outputs:
      _DataOut: any
      _Error: any
    config:
    - label: Endpoint
      name: endpoint
      type: string
    - label: User
      name: user
      type: string
    - label: Password
      name: password
      type: string
    - label: Key Token
      name: keyToken
      type: string
    - label: Proxy
      name: proxy
      type: string
    - label: Proxy Port
      name: proxyPort
      type: number
    - label: Proxy User
      name: proxyUser
      type: string
    - label: Proxy Password
      name: proxyPassword
      type: string
    description: |
      This node performs authentication against a BMC Remedy endpoint using provided credentials and stores a JWT token in flow state.

      It sends a POST request with form-encoded user credentials to the /api/jwt/login path constructed from the configured endpoint. On success it assigns the input data to the output and stores a prefixed JWT token under the key token config name in flowStore. On HTTP error or exception it populates an error output with status details and logs appropriate messages.

      Args:
        _DataIn (any): Input data passed into the node for processing.

      Returns:
        _DataOut (any): Output data, set to input data on successful login.
        _Error (any): Error object containing status, statusText, and body on failure.

      Config:
        endpoint (string): BMC Remedy server base URL used to construct the login endpoint path.
        user (string): Username for authenticating with BMC Remedy.
        password (string): Password for authenticating with BMC Remedy.
        keyToken (string): Flow state key where the resulting JWT token will be stored.
        proxy (string): Proxy server address to use for HTTP requests.
        proxyPort (number): Port number for the proxy server.
        proxyUser (string): Username for authenticating with the proxy server.
        proxyPassword (string): Password for authenticating with the proxy server.
  BMC:RemedyFetch:
    group: BMC
    action: remedyFetch
    inputs:
      _DataIn: any
    outputs:
      _DataOut: any
      _Error: any
    config:
    - label: Endpoint
      name: endpoint
      type: string
    - label: Key Token
      name: keyToken
      type: string
    - label: Form
      name: form
      type: string
    - label: Query
      name: query
      type: string
    - label: Limit
      name: limit
      type: number
    - label: Fetch all
      name: fetchAll
      type: boolean
      defaultValue: true
    - label: Fields To Return
      name: fieldsToReturn
      type: string
    - label: Proxy
      name: proxy
      type: string
    - label: Proxy Port
      name: proxyPort
      type: number
    - label: Proxy User
      name: proxyUser
      type: string
    - label: Proxy Password
      name: proxyPassword
      type: string
    description: |
      The BMC:RemedyFetch node retrieves entries from a BMC Remedy AR System API endpoint using provided configuration parameters. It processes a single input payload and outputs the fetched records as a list of entry values or an error object if the request fails.

      The node first constructs the Remedy API endpoint using the configured endpoint and form name, appending optional field filters and query string parameters. It sets up HTTP headers with an authorization token retrieved from flowStore using the configured keyToken. The node then executes an HTTP GET request with support for proxy settings. If the response status is not in the 2xx range, it creates an _Error object with the status code, text, and parsed body, logs the error, and exits. On success, it collects the entry values from the first response and, if fetchAll is enabled, iterates through paginated responses using a while loop over the _links.next.href until no next page exists. During this iteration, each subsequent response's entries are appended to the result list. All error paths, including exceptions in the try block, result in an _Error output.

      Args:
        _DataIn (any): Input payload passed into the node for processing.

      Returns:
        _DataOut (any): Output containing the list of retrieved entry values from BMC Remedy, or null on error.
        _Error (any): Output containing an error object with status, statusText, and body when the request or processing fails.

      Config:
        endpoint (string): Base URL of the BMC Remedy AR System API endpoint.
        keyToken (string): Key used to retrieve the authorization token from flowStore.
        form (string): Name of the BMC Remedy form to query.
        query (string): Query string to filter records in the form.
        limit (number): Maximum number of records to fetch in the first request.
        fetchAll (boolean): Flag indicating whether to fetch all pages of results.
        fieldsToReturn (string): Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response.
        proxy (string): Hostname or IP address of the proxy server to use for HTTP requests.
        proxyPort (number): Port number of the proxy server.
        proxyUser (string): Username for proxy authentication.
        proxyPassword (string): Password for proxy authentication.
  BMC:RemedyUpdate:
    group: BMC
    action: remedyUpdate
    inputs:
      _DataIn: any
    outputs:
      _DataOut: any
      _Error: any
    config:
    - label: Endpoint
      name: endpoint
      type: string
    - label: Key Token
      name: keyToken
      type: string
    - label: Form
      name: form
      type: string
    - label: Entry ID
      name: entryID
      type: string
    - label: Update Values
      name: updateValues
      type: string
    - label: Proxy
      name: proxy
      type: string
    - label: Proxy Port
      name: proxyPort
      type: number
    - label: Proxy User
      name: proxyUser
      type: string
    - label: Proxy Password
      name: proxyPassword
      type: string
    description: |
      This node updates an entry in BMC Remedy by sending an HTTP PUT request with update values, then fetches the updated entry using an HTTP GET request, returning a list of entry objects with key-value pairs.

      The node evaluates its configuration, constructs an endpoint URL for the specified form and entry ID, and sends an authenticated PUT request using an authorization token retrieved from flowStore. If the PUT response is not successful (status outside 200-299), an error object is created and returned. If the PUT succeeds, the node sends a GET request to the same form endpoint with a query filter for the entry ID to retrieve the updated data. The GET response body is parsed, and for each entry in the "entries" array, the node iterates over its "values" array to build a map of key-value pairs, which is collected into a list and assigned to _DataOut. Errors during execution or status failures in either HTTP call are captured and stored in _Error, with logging performed in both cases.

      Args:
        _DataIn (any): Input data passed to the node for processing

      Returns:
        _DataOut (any): Output data containing a list of maps representing the updated entry's field keys and values
        _Error (any): Error object describing failures including HTTP status, statusText, and reason/body

      Config:

    config:
    - label: Message
      name: message
      type: string
    description: |
      This node logs an informational message containing a configurable string and the input value, then passes the input through unchanged.

      The action method assigns the input value to the output, then constructs a log entry by concatenating the configured message with a space, the string representation of the input value, and logs it with INFO level.

      Args:
        _In (any): The input value to be logged and passed through.

      Returns:
        _Out (any): The input value passed through unchanged.

      Config:
        message (string): The message string to prefix in the log entry.
  Core:Template:
    group: Transform
    action: template
    inputs:
      _Data: any
    outputs:
      _Payload: any
    config:
    - label: template
      name: template
      type: string
      rows: 8
    - label: Output Format
      name: outputFormat
      inputType: select
      defaultValue: xml
      options:
      - html
      - xml
      type: string
    description: |
      The Core:Template node processes input data by applying a user-defined FreeMarker template and returns the rendered output as the payload. It supports two output formats, HTML and XML, by prepending a corresponding FreeMarker directive to the template.

      The node retrieves the template string and output format from configuration, modifies the template content based on the selected format by prepending a FreeMarker language directive, then processes the input data with the FreeMarker template engine to produce the final string output.

      Args:
        _Data (any): Input data passed to the template for processing.

      Returns:
        _Payload (any): The rendered output string produced by processing the input data with the configured template.

      Config:
        template (string): The FreeMarker template string used to process the input data.
        outputFormat (string): The target output format, either "html" or "xml", which determines the FreeMarker directive prepended to the template.
  Core:SendEmail:
    group: Outbound
    action: sendEmail
    inputs:
      body: string
    outputs:
      _Error: any
    config:
    - label: Type
      name: mailType
      inputType: select
      defaultValue: text/plain
      options:
      - text/html
      - text/plain
      type: string
    - label: SMTP Server
      name: smtpServer
      type: string
    - label: SMTP Port
      name: smtpPort
      type: string
    - label: Use TLS
      name: usetls
      type: boolean
      defaultValue: true
    - label: From
      name: from
      type: string
    - label: Password
      name: password
      type: string
      inputType: password
    - label: SMTP Authentication
      name: auth
      type: boolean
      defaultValue: true
    - label: Subject
      name: subject
      type: string
    - label: To
      name: to
      type: string
    description: |
      The Core:SendEmail node sends an email using SMTP by consuming input body content and configuration parameters.

      It parses the "to" recipients by splitting on semicolons, constructs an Email object, and invokes its send method with all provided SMTP and email parameters. If the send operation fails, it captures the exception and sets a structured error response; otherwise, it clears the error output.

      Args:
        body (string): The content body of the email to be sent, passed as input to the node.

      Returns:
        _Error (any): Set to a map containing status 500, statusText, and error body if email sending fails; set to null on success.

      Config:
        mailType (string): The MIME type of the email content, such as text/plain or text/html.
        smtpServer (string): The hostname or IP address of the SMTP server.
        smtpPort (string): The port number used to connect to the SMTP server.
        usetls (boolean): Indicates whether TLS encryption should be used for the SMTP connection.
        from (string): The sender email address.
        password (string): The password used for SMTP authentication.
        auth (boolean): Indicates whether SMTP authentication is required.
        subject (string): The subject line of the email.
        to (string): The recipient email addresses, semicolon-separated.
  Core:TranslateWithDeepl:
    group: Translate
    action: translateWithDeepl
    inputs:
      _Data: any
    outputs:
      _Translation: any
      _DetectedSourceLanguage: any
      _Error: any
    config:
    - label: Source Language
      name: sourceLanguage
      inputType: select
      defaultValue: Detect
      options:
      - Detect
      - DE
      - EN
      - FR
      - IT
      - JA
      - ES
      - NL
      - PL
      - PT
      - RU
      - ZH
      type: string
    - label: Target Language
      name: targetLanguage
      inputType: select
      defaultValue: EN
      options:
      - DE
      - EN
      - FR
      - IT
      - JA
      - ES
      - NL
      - PL
      - PT
      - RU
      - ZH
      type: string
    - label: Text To Translate
      name: textToTranslate
      type: string
    - label: API Key
      name: apiKey
      type: string
    - label: Proxy
      name: proxy
      type: string
    - label: Proxy Port
      name: proxyPort
      type: number
    - label: Proxy User
      name: proxyUser
      type: string
    - label: Proxy Password
      name: proxyPassword
      type: string
      inputType: password
    description: |
      This node performs translation using the DeepL API by sending an HTTP POST request with provided text and configuration parameters. It extracts the translated text and detected source language from the API response, or sets an error if the request or processing fails.

      The node evaluates the incoming data configuration, prepares query parameters with the API key, target language, and text to translate, optionally including the source language if not set to "Detect". It then executes an HTTP POST request to the DeepL translation endpoint, using proxy settings from config if provided. Upon successful response, it assigns the first translation's text and detected source language to output fields. If any exception occurs during execution, it constructs an error object with a 500 status, logs the error, and sets the _Error output.

      Args:
        _Data (any): Input data containing node configuration and payload for translation processing.

      Returns:
        _Translation (any): The translated text output from the DeepL API response.
        _DetectedSourceLanguage (any): The detected source language code returned by the DeepL API.
        _Error (any): Error object containing status, statusText, and body when an exception occurs during execution.

      Config:
        sourceLanguage (string): Source language code for translation; if "Detect", source language is inferred automatically.
        targetLanguage (string): Target language code for desired translation output.
        textToTranslate (string): The text string to be translated by the DeepL API.
        apiKey (string): DeepL API authentication key used for API access.
        proxy (string): Proxy server host address for HTTP requests, if needed.
        proxyPort (number): Proxy server port number for HTTP requests.
        proxyUser (string): Proxy server username for authentication, if required.
        proxyPassword (string): Proxy server password for authentication, if required.
  Core:RunShellCommand:

    description: |

        _Data (any): Input data used for configuration evaluation

      Returns:
        _ExecutionResult (any): Map containing 'out' and 'error' streams from the shell command execution
        _Error (any): Map with status code, status text, and error body when an exception occurs during execution

  Core:AddToQueue:
    group: Adapter
    action: coreAddToQueue
    inputs:
      _Data: any
    outputs:
      _ID: any
      _Error: any
    config:
    - label: Name Of Queue
      name: queueName
      type: string
    - label: $Document
      name: document
      type: string
      rows: 8
    description: |
      The Core:AddToQueue node adds a document to a named queue by invoking the adapter's addToQueue method. It expects input data as _Data and produces a queue entry ID or an error record depending on execution success.

      In the try block, the node evaluates configuration using _Data and then calls adapter.addToQueue with configData.queueName and configData.document, assigning the result to _ID. In the catch block, if an exception occurs, _Error is assigned a map containing status 500, statusText, and the exception's string representation, and an error is logged.

      Args:
        _Data (any): Input data passed to the node for processing

      Returns:
        _ID (any): Identifier returned by the adapter's addToQueue call if successful
        _Error (any): Error map with status, statusText, and body if an exception occurs

      Config:
        queueName (string): Name of the queue to which the document will be added
        document (string): Document content to be enqueued, editable in a text area with 8 rows
  Core:UpdateQueue:

    outputs:

      _Error: any

    - label: ID Of Document

    description: |
      This node updates a queue with a new document using provided configuration parameters.

      The node takes input data and passes it through unchanged if the operation succeeds. It uses the adapter's updateQueue method to update the specified queue with the provided document ID and content. If an exception occurs during execution, it builds an error object with a 500 status code, a standard error message, and the exception details, then logs the error with flow and node context.

      Args:
        _Data (any): Input data passed through to output on success.

      Returns:
        _Out (any): Output data identical to input when the queue update succeeds.
        _Error (any): Error object with status 500, statusText, and body containing exception details when an error occurs.

      Config:

        documentID (string): ID of the document to update in the queue.
        document (string): Full content of the document to store in the queue.
  Core:GetDocumentFromQueue:
